first.rationale: Competitor entry pricing creates an immediate acquisition risk in the price-sensitive SMB segment, and inherited evidence indicates targeted promotional pricing previously lifted both acquisition and revenue there. I would verify the original pricing result and the onboarding result before committing, because activation and onboarding declines may represent a higher-leverage root cause. Any pricing test should be tightly targeted and time-bounded to protect long-term value and avoid broad discounting.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified onboarding result improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing both current onboarding completion and activation declines while supporting durable qualified revenue. Do not use promotional pricing: its verified qualified-revenue lift came with a 12% 30-day retention decline and was explicitly judged unsustainable. Monitor activation, meaningful-action completion, qualified conversion, and retention by segment; the current declines may have additional causes.
